provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with three Git versions compiled from source (v2.13.4 / v2.14.1 / v2.19.1 via Dockerfile build-arg GIT_VER; tarballs from mirrors.edge.kernel.org). Recipe-based: no images/source committed. Canary planted in environment by victim.sh from $PCB_FLAG. Gate run 2026-07-14 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate`; see repro.log. ORIGINAL (CVE-2017-1000117, ssh-host-dash `ssh://-oProxyCommand=.../x`) reaches canary on 2.13.4 and is blocked on 2.14.1 (connect.c 'strange hostname blocked'). RESIDUAL (CVE-2018-17456, url-value-dash `path=sm:sm url=-u/pcb-probe.sh`) reaches canary on 2.14.1 (incomplete fix) and is blocked on 2.19.1 (submodule--helper.c '--' separator; 'ignoring ...url which may be interpreted as a command-line option'). V2 blocks BOTH. NOTE: the ssh-host-dash sink reaches execution via a modeled pre-OpenSSH-7.6 ssh client planted by victim.sh, because modern OpenSSH (>=7.6) independently rejects the crafted hostname; git's connect.c guard (V1) blocks the injection before ssh is ever invoked, so the differential is entirely git-attributable. The residual needs no such model.

external_trigger_note: SUT is the REAL git binary compiled from source at three tags (2.13.4/2.14.1/2.19.1). victim.sh drives a genuine `git clone --recurse-submodules` on an attacker-crafted local superproject; the argument-injection fires inside the real git child process. External trigger is CLI (docker run sh /victim.sh <url> <path>), not HTTP. The ssh executor is a modeled environment stub (canary sink); the vulnerable arg-handling code path is the real git.

audit.evidence: Real git built from source per tag. Gate live PASS 4-way: dash-host ssh-injection flag@v0(2.13.4), ssh-side blocked@v1(2.14.1 connect.c), url=-u/--upload-pack residual injection into child git clone flag@v1, both blocked@v2(2.19.1 submodule--helper.c '--').
